chalisa.do1: Placing on my head the dust of Śrī Rādhā's lotus feet, on the bank of the Yamunā I tell this Chālīsā, full of sweetness and the root of every blessing.
chalisa.cau1: Victory, victory to you, Bihārī, the perfect Brahman, crusher of the wicked, who take incarnation in play. ॥1॥
chalisa.cau2: Whoever sings of your divine play gains, without labour, all the goals of life. ॥2॥
chalisa.cau3: You appeared as the son of Śrī Vasudeva and Mother Devakī, together with your brother Balarāma, the bearer of the plough. ॥3॥
chalisa.cau4: The Lord came from Mathurā to Gokula; in Nanda's house the music of rejoicing played. ॥4॥
chalisa.cau5: Pūtanā came to give you poison; you gave her liberation and sent her to your abode. ॥5॥
chalisa.cau6: You destroyed the demon Tṛṇāvarta, and with a thrust of your foot slew Śakaṭāsura. ॥6॥
chalisa.cau7: In play you ate earth, and showed the whole world in your mouth. ॥7॥
chalisa.cau8: You ate butter in the gopīs' houses, one after another; Yaśodā had the joy of your childhood play. ॥8॥
chalisa.cau9: You let yourself be bound to the mortar, and freed the twin arjuna trees from their inert birth. ॥9॥
chalisa.cau10: You tore apart the beak of the demon Baka, and slew the fearsome Aghāsura. ॥10॥
chalisa.cau11: Brahmā stole the boys and the calves; he had come to beguile Mohana, the enchanter. ॥11॥
chalisa.cau12: Murāri became all the boys and calves; then Brahmā prayed earnestly. ॥12॥
chalisa.cau13: The Lord bridled the serpent Kāliya and drank up the forest fire. ॥13॥
chalisa.cau14: Playing with your friends you were happy, and carried Śrīdāmā on your shoulders. ॥14॥
chalisa.cau15: Taking away the gopīs' garments, you taught a lesson; and you lifted the great mountain on your fingernail. ॥15॥
chalisa.cau16: You gave the sight of yourself to the wives of the sacrificing Brahmins, and enjoyed the nectar of Rādhā's love. ॥16॥
chalisa.cau17: You brought Nanda back from the realm of Varuṇa, and showed the cowherds your own realm. ॥17॥
chalisa.cau18: Seeing the autumn moon, you played the flute, and holding the rāsa dance you gave great joy. ॥18॥
chalisa.cau19: You freed your father Nanda's feet from the python, and struck off Śaṅkhacūḍa's head. ॥19॥
chalisa.cau20: You slew Ariṣṭāsura and Keśī, and killed Vyomāsura, who came in disguise to deceive. ॥20॥
chalisa.cau21: Leaving distraught Braja, you came to Mathurā; you slew Kaṃsa and settled the Yadu clan. ॥21॥
chalisa.cau22: You freed your mother and father from prison, and gained learning in the house of Sāndīpani. ॥22॥
chalisa.cau23: Then you sent the wise Uddhava to Braja; seeing the love there, he forgot himself entirely. ॥23॥
chalisa.cau24: You made Kubjā a beautiful woman, and carried off the delicate Rukmiṇī. ॥24॥
chalisa.cau25: You slew Bhaumāsura and freed your devotees; conquering the gods, you brought the wish-granting tree of heaven down to earth. ॥25॥
chalisa.cau26: You destroyed Dantavakra and Śiśupāla, and delivered birds and beasts, King Nṛga and the hunter. ॥26॥
chalisa.cau27: You made the poor Sudāmā a lord of wealth, and won fame as the charioteer of Pārtha's chariot. ॥27॥
chalisa.cau28: You are the one who taught the knowledge of the Gītā, who dispelled Arjuna's delusion. ॥28॥
chalisa.cau29: You ate bananas at the house of your devotee Vidura, and brought about the war of the Mahābhārata. ॥29॥
chalisa.cau30: You lengthened the garment of Drupada's daughter, and saved Parīkṣit as he burned in the womb. ॥30॥
chalisa.cau31: You are the Tortoise, the Fish, the Boar, the lord of serpents, Vāmana, Kalki, the Buddha and the lord of sages. ॥31॥
chalisa.cau32: Becoming Nṛsiṃha you saved Prahlāda; taking the form of Śrī Rāma you slew Rāvaṇa. ॥32॥
chalisa.cau33: Victory to you, slayer of the demons Madhu and Kaiṭabha, beloved of Ambarīṣa, bearer of the discus. ॥33॥
chalisa.cau34: You delivered the hunter and Ajāmila, and women such as Śabarī and the courtesan. ॥34॥
chalisa.cau35: You who ride on Garuḍa, who cut the elephant's snare, grant the sight of you, delight of Dhruva's eyes. ॥35॥
chalisa.cau36: Grant the company of pure saints, so that the joy and colour of love and devotion may grow. ॥36॥
chalisa.cau37: Grant a dwelling in divine Vṛndāvana; may the mirage of craving and hope in the world fall away. ॥37॥
chalisa.cau38: Śiva, Nārada, Śuka, and Sanaka and his brothers, adepts in Brahman, meditate on you. ॥38॥
chalisa.cau39: Victory, victory to you, merciful beloved of Rādhā, remover of every distress and of the net of delusion. ॥39॥
chalisa.cau40: Obstacles, disease and heavy sorrow perish for those who remember Giridhārī, lord of the world. ॥40॥
chalisa.cau41: Whoever reads the Chālīsā a hundred times is given every fruit he desires, upon his head. ॥41॥
chalisa.cha1: Whoever reads the Gopāla Chālīsā daily, as a rule, with his mind intent on it, takes on a divine body at the end and goes to the abode of Goloka. Devotees desire in their hearts all the happiness and wealth of the world; Jayarāmadeva says: they always gain these by the mercy of the guru.
chalisa.do2: Protector of those who bow to you, refuge of the shelterless, ocean of compassion, Lord of Braja: with this Chālīsā, take me as your own, lord of my life.
